title: Hanasato Minori — Positive Flower〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Haruka, thanks for waiting!
Let's have... Oh, I guess she's not here yet.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (In that case, I think I'll take another look at the comments from our first stream yesterday.)

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<I'm so happy I get to see Haruka again!>
<I loved getting to hear how Airi felt!>
<Shizuku's as beautiful as ever.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I'm glad the others were able to express how they really felt to their fans too.)

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Can even Haruka handle freelancing?>
<What are they thinking? Just join an agency already.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Hm... It looks like some people don't think this is going to work. Still, we just started! This is only the beginning!)

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Who was that last girl?>
<I've never seen her before.>
<Who was that? Show her again...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(There are comments about me too!
I've gotta keep doing more and more!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sorry to keep you waiting.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, Haruka! That's okay. I just got here too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: If it means getting to have lunch with you, Haruka, I can wait as long as it takes!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. Well, I've kept you waiting long enough.
Let's eat, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me... Did you have any problems coming to school this morning?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I was worried that you might've drawn some extra attention on your way here because of our first livestream yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I appreciate the concern, but I didn't have any trouble. I wore a disguise.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A disguise?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. It's common knowledge that Airi, Shizuku and I attend this school.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's why I wear my regular clothes on the way here and change into my uniform afterwards. I was wearing a hat and sunglasses, so I don't think anyone recognized me.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh! I should've known!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Still, it can't be easy. Having to wear a disguise means you always have to carry a change of clothes with you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's not so bad. I wouldn't mind if it was just me, but I can't very well cause trouble for the school.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I only really wear a disguise when I'm alone as well.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? Really?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. If I'm with my friends, for example, something simple is usually enough. I'm guessing people find it harder to talk to me when I'm with others.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I think I understand. I'd feel bad about disrupting your personal time since talking to you then would be kind of rude.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Looks like I was right.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's thanks to the fans' consideration that I'm able to avoid inconveniencing my friends. It's also really nice being able to get a breather and just shop once in a while.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I have to think Airi and Shizuku feel the same way.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh! If you wear a disguise to school, that probably means they're doing the same thing.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Airi for sure. From what I understand, she almost always wears a disguise out in public.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I don't think Shizuku does much more than changing how she dresses and putting on a pair of glasses.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Come to think of it, Shizuku's someone you'd just recognize with a quick glance.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But she has this aura that might make it hard to approach her even if you do realize who she is...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I guess that's true.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'll have to start making sure I don't cause trouble for those around me as well.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: On the other hand, nobody even knows who I am yet, so it's probably way too early for me to even worry...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I don't think that's true at all.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's great you're already thinking about how to protect the smiles of those around you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! N-No, it's nothing as great as that. I just thought it'd be rude to inconvenience others by simply doing the things I like!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I'm wondering if I can pull off a disguise too...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I feel like I'll end up picking a look that ends up making me stick out even more!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I can imagine you walking around looking all worried that you'll be made.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I knew it! Maybe I should start practicing now...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Let me know when you want to try and I'll give you some pointers.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh! That would be great!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The first step is getting enough recognition so that a disguise becomes necessary!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's do our best, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!
